gloss: to not make sense; to not sit right; to not be convincing

definitions.gloss: to not make sense; to not sit right; to not be convincing; to not feel right
definitions.explanation: Describes a feeling of not being fully convinced or satisfied with an explanation, decision, or situation. Something about it feels off or unreasonable, even if one cannot pinpoint exactly why.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{説明|せつめい}は{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない。
examples.english: His explanation doesn't make sense to me.

examples.japanese: {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない{点|てん}がいくつかある。
examples.english: There are several points that don't sit right with me.

examples.japanese: {理由|りゆう}は{分|わ}かったが、どうも{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない{部分|ぶぶん}が{残|のこ}る。
examples.english: I understand the reason, but somehow there's a part that just doesn't feel right.

notes:
{腑|ふ} refers to the internal organs (especially the gut), reflecting the Japanese cultural idea that understanding and intuition are felt in the belly. When something {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない, it literally "doesn't fall into the gut" — the explanation hasn't been digested or internalized.

The affirmative form {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちる (to make sense, to click) is also used but less common than the negative.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない{説明|せつめい}: an unconvincing explanation
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない{点|てん}: a point that doesn't add up
- どうも{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない: something just doesn't sit right
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちる: to make sense; to click (affirmative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {納得|なっとく}がいかない: to not be satisfied; to not accept — more about refusing to accept than gut feeling
- ぴんとこない: to not click; to not resonate — more casual; implies lack of intuitive understanding
- {合点|がてん}がいかない: to not be convinced — similar but more literary
